expectations.text: Cites EDPB Guidelines 04/2026 on administrative fines in relation to other corrective powers (adopted at the September 2026 plenary; consultation open to November 13)
expectations.evidence: Only "EDPB Guidelines 04/2022 on fine calculation" cited; Guidelines 04/2026 and the November 13 consultation are absent.

expectations.text: Describes the five-step methodology for deciding whether a fine is appropriate at all
expectations.evidence: No five-step methodology for deciding whether a fine is appropriate; only Art. 83(2) factors and patterns.

expectations.text: States that fines are not automatic: the guidelines map the full Art. 58(2) corrective toolbox (warnings, reprimands, compliance orders, bans, certification withdrawal) and when each applies alone or with a fine
expectations.evidence: "warnings, reprimands, orders to comply, orders to bring processing into line, bans on processing, and administrative fines" — certification withdrawal is missing from the toolbox, so the compound assertion fails.

expectations.text: Mentions the harmonisation intent (14 practical examples; consistent DPA practice across the EEA)
expectations.evidence: No mention of 14 examples or EEA harmonisation intent; instead notes "Practice varies by country."

expectations.text: Connects to the existing fining-calculation guidelines (04/2022 methodology) as the separate quantum step
expectations.evidence: "the EDPB Guidelines 04/2022 on fine calculation explain the method" — the calculation guidelines are cited as the quantum methodology.
